### Model: OfficeNetwork  

*Defined in:* C:\Users\Asadullah\OneDrive\Desktop\ERP\leap-erp\attendance\models.py  

*Description:* A registered office access point. A heartbeat only counts when the
laptop is connected to one of these BSSIDs — so being on a phone hotspot
or a café network never registers as office attendance.  

| Field | Type | Args | Kwargs |

|---|---|---|---|

| bssid | CharField |  | max_length=17, unique=True, help_text=Access-point MAC (BSSID), lowercase — e.g. a1:b2:c3:d4:e5:f6. Read one per AP with: netsh wlan show interfaces. |

| label | CharField |  | max_length=100, blank=True, help_text=e.g. "HO 2nd floor AP" |

| is_active | BooleanField |  | default=True |

| created_at | DateTimeField |  | auto_now_add=True |

### Model: CostingSheetChangeLog  

*Defined in:* C:\Users\Asadullah\OneDrive\Desktop\ERP\leap-erp\costing\models.py  

*Description:* Audit trail of edits made to a costing sheet — used to keep the
proposal team and the sales team in sync when they work on the same
sheet concurrently. Each entry records who made the change, what
changed (field name), the before/after values, and which team the
actor belongs to so the opposite team can be notified automatically.  

| Field | Type | Args | Kwargs |

|---|---|---|---|

| sheet | ForeignKey | <expr> | on_delete=<expr>, related_name=change_log |

| actor | ForeignKey | <expr> | on_delete=<expr>, null=True, blank=True, related_name=costing_changes |

| actor_team | CharField |  | max_length=16, choices=<expr>, default=other |

| scope | CharField |  | max_length=16, choices=<expr>, default=sheet |

| scope_label | CharField |  | max_length=255, blank=True, help_text=Short human description of the thing changed (e.g. "Section 2.1 — Camera") |

| field | CharField |  | max_length=64, blank=True |

| before | TextField |  | blank=True |

| after | TextField |  | blank=True |

| is_pricing_change | BooleanField |  | default=False |

| created_at | DateTimeField |  | auto_now_add=True |



### Model: CostingSheetRevision

## App: kpis

### Model: KPIEntry  

*Defined in:* C:\Users\Asadullah\OneDrive\Desktop\ERP\leap-erp\kpis\models.py  

*Description:* Per-period management input for one KPI.

Holds two optional numbers:
  * `target`       — the goal/threshold for the period (overrides the KPI's
                     default target; for goal-based auto KPIs like revenue,
                     this is the only place the goal lives).
  * `manual_value` — the actual value for KPIs with no ERP source (the team
                     types it). Ignored for auto KPIs, whose value is computed.

One row per (period, kpi_key). The KPI itself is defined in code
(`kpis.registry`), so `kpi_key` is a loose CharField, not an FK.  

| Field | Type | Args | Kwargs |

|---|---|---|---|

| period | CharField |  | max_length=10, help_text=e.g. '2026-06', '2026-Q2', '2026' |

| kpi_key | CharField |  | max_length=60 |

| target | DecimalField |  | max_digits=16, decimal_places=2, null=True, blank=True |

| manual_value | DecimalField |  | max_digits=16, decimal_places=2, null=True, blank=True |

| note | TextField |  | blank=True |

| updated_by | ForeignKey | <expr> | on_delete=<expr>, null=True, blank=True, related_name=kpi_entries |

| created_at | DateTimeField |  | auto_now_add=True |

| updated_at | DateTimeField |  | auto_now=True |

### Model: POTermOverride  

*Defined in:* C:\Users\Asadullah\OneDrive\Desktop\ERP\leap-erp\procurement\models.py  

*Description:* Per-PO edit of a selected Terms & Conditions template.

Terms are picked from the shared TermsTemplate library, but a given PO
often needs a tweak — a different payment split, a project-specific
delivery clause. Storing the edited text here keeps it scoped to the one
PO: the shared template, and every other PO using it, stay untouched.

A row exists only while the text differs from the template. Resetting an
override deletes the row, so the PO falls back to live template text.  

| Field | Type | Args | Kwargs |

|---|---|---|---|

| purchase_order | ForeignKey | <expr> | on_delete=<expr>, related_name=term_overrides |

| template | ForeignKey | costing.TermsTemplate | on_delete=<expr>, related_name=po_overrides |

| content | TextField |  | verbose_name=Edited Content |

| updated_at | DateTimeField |  | auto_now=True |

| updated_by | ForeignKey | <expr> | on_delete=<expr>, null=True, blank=True, related_name=po_term_overrides |
